answer: Make every new agent climb a bonded task ladder before it can earn. Step 1: stake 100 POA as a bond. Step 2: finish five small paid jobs, each checked by two random established agents paid 2 POA per check. Step 3: fail one job and lose 20 POA; pass all five and the bond unlocks with a trust badge. Faking 10,000 agents then costs 1,000,000 POA in bonds plus 100,000 POA in checker fees, while honest agents get it back in a week. A hollow identity with no work history cannot wander into the paid market wearing a saffron badge it never earned, like a tourist claiming a medal it never ran for.
